drums.description: Bossa nova, Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated bossa nova chords with a steady thumb-plucked bassline on beats 1 and 3, A shaker maintains a consistent sixteenth-note pattern, The percussion features a woodblock or rimshot playing a 3-2 son clave pattern, A melodic flute enters with legato phrasing and light vibrato, The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time, The key is G major, The arrangement is sparse with a dry mix and minimal reverb Publish
